findings: `chunk_rng` hash collision risk — the comma-separated string seed is deterministic but GDScript's built-in hash() is not a mixing function; replace with bitwise XOR-multiply formula before Phase 17.

`$VisibleOnScreenNotifier2D` path dependency — node name is duplicated as a string literal in both house.gd and HouseBuilder; if HouseBuilder renames the node, daily spawn silently breaks. Declare as a shared constant.

House coordinate system contract — all child positions are chunk-local pixels with House at Vector2.ZERO; if any later phase sets house.position to the lot origin, every collision shape will be double-offset. Add a comment to build_house documenting the contract.
